description: This file defines functions and schemas for fetching and parsing Vercel AI Gateway models, focusing on language models, including schema validation, API interaction, and model info parsing.

methods.name: getVercelAiGatewayModels
methods.description: Fetches models from Vercel AI Gateway API, filters for language models, and returns a record of model info.

methods.name: parseVercelAiGatewayModel
methods.description: Parses a VercelAiGatewayModel object into a ModelInfo structure, including pricing and feature support.
